name: workmars
description: WorkMars — free, unlimited-user project management with boards, sprints, a personal to-do list and a free built-in AI guide.

scripts.dev: node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning scripts/preflight.mjs && concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start: node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning scripts/preflight.mjs && npm run start -w server
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
